definitions: To control the operations of; manage or govern.
To point or aim (something) in a particular direction.
To supervise the making of (a film or play) and control the artistic aspects of its production.
To cause to move or travel in a particular direction.
examples: He directed the company for many years.
She directed her gaze towards the window.
The teacher directed the students to open their books.
The sign directed us to the motorway.
